name: sintem
long_description: Most phones are built to keep you on them. We make an agentic phone that puts an army of agents to work for you. Tell it what you need done, and they handle it across the tools and apps you already use. You get more work done with less time on your screen.
one_liner: An agentic phone that does your busywork

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Founder of Sintem (F26): agentic phones for teams.

Won OpenAI's hackathon at their HQ solo, building an agentic OS for phones. Previously founded droov (Shopify for restaurants), with $3.4M+ GMV and 32K+ users across Germany, Austria, and Belgium. Co-founded an ed-tech SaaS ($1.1M+ ARR). Founded Reinio (Uber for laundry) and sold it to Munich's largest laundromat chain.

Technical University of Munich (TUM) graduate.

Competed internationally in Judo: 90+ competitions, about 300 matches.
